acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /api/projects/:id/workspaces returns 200 with a JSON array of all workspaces for the project
POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces returns 201 on valid input and 400 on missing required fields
GET /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid returns 200 with the workspace object or 404 with { error } when not found
PUT /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/rename returns 200 with the updated object, or 404 if the ID does not exist
DELETE /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid returns 204 on success, or 404 if the ID does not exist

summary: QA passed for WP-007 (Workspace API Routes). 495/495 tests pass, 0 failures. All 6 acceptance criteria verified. 16 unit tests cover all 6 handlers: GET list, POST create, GET by-id, PUT update-description, PUT rename, DELETE. MockWorkspaceManager is a complete in-memory implementation with 6 methods (list, getById, create, update, rename, remove) plus seedProject() helper. Key test: STABLE rename returns 400 (not 404) confirming the string-match heuristic correctly classifies STABLE protection errors. Side-effect verification confirmed for DELETE (wm.getById returns undefined after delete). No regressions detected."

comments.note: STABLE rename test (line 345) verifies the 404/400 discrimination correctly: rename() for STABLE throws 'Cannot rename the STABLE workspace...' which does not contain 'does not exist', so it maps to 400. This is intentional and the test explicitly verifies it.
DELETE side-effect is verified via wm.getById('proj-a', 'DEV') === undefined (line 372), which is a strong post-condition check not present in all other delete tests. Good practice.

The PUT update-description route returns 404 for any exception from workspaceManager.update() — both project-not-found and workspace-not-found cases map to 404. This is consistent but slightly lossy (both errors get same status). Not a bug, just worth noting for code review.

summary: Code review PASS for WP-007 (Workspace API Routes).

src/server/routes/workspaces.ts: Implements all 6 routes cleanly. Same structural pattern as repositories.ts and projects.ts throughout. isPlainObject() guard, parseJsonBody() for async handlers, sendJson/sendError wiring.
GET /api/projects/:id/workspaces (list): wraps list() in try/catch, maps any exception to 404. Correct — WorkspaceManager.list() throws when the project doesn't exist.
POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces: uses the familiar `msg.includes('does not exist')` heuristic to discriminate 404 vs 400. Correct for all current error paths from create().

PUT /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid (update description): maps ALL update() exceptions to 404. QA/handoff note flags this as 'lossy'. On inspection, update() only throws for project-not-found ('does not exist') and workspace-not-found ('does not exist') — both ARE 404. So the blanket 404 mapping is semantically correct for all currently reachable error paths, though it foregoes the string-match refinement used by other handlers. Acceptable.

PUT /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/rename: correctly uses the heuristic. Comment on line 191–192 correctly documents that STABLE/Invalid/already-exists errors map to 400, not-found maps to 404. The STABLE rename test explicitly verifies the heuristic fires correctly.

DELETE /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid: maps all remove() exceptions to 404. remove() can throw for STABLE protection ('Cannot remove the STABLE workspace') which does not contain 'does not exist' — this would produce a 404 instead of the more semantically correct 400/405. However: (1) the AC only requires 404 for ID-not-found, (2) STABLE deletion being a client error communicated as 404 is an edge-case, and (3) no test exercises this path. Low-priority observation, does not block.

Test file: 16 tests covering all 6 handlers and all AC branches. MockWorkspaceManager is the richest of the three test mocks: seedProject() helper, requireProject() shared guard, full implementation of all 6 methods. flushAsync() reused from projects.test.ts convention. STABLE rename test (line 345) is a valuable negative-heuristic verification.
495/495 tests pass. All 6 ACs confirmed met.

comments.note: isPlainObject() is defined locally in workspaces.ts, identical to the copies in repositories.ts and projects.ts. Third instance of the same duplication. Extraction to requestUtils.ts is now more compelling with three route files carrying the same 3-line helper.

DELETE /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid maps any remove() exception to 404 (line 208-209). remove() throws a STABLE-protection error that does not contain 'does not exist', so a DELETE /STABLE request would return 404 with a message like 'Cannot remove the STABLE workspace...'. The HTTP status is technically incorrect (400 or 405 would be more accurate for a protection violation). Low-risk in practice since the GUI should prevent this action, but worth a follow-up test + fix.
The JSDoc table comment (lines 26-33) lists only 5 routes but the note on line 34 acknowledges the 6th. The table itself should list PUT /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid explicitly for completeness.

notes: All 6 ACs met. 495/495 tests pass. Clean for code review. Note for reviewer: PUT update-description maps all update() exceptions to 404 regardless of cause — acceptable but worth reviewing for consistency with other routes.
